items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of water-law permit for jetty
items.quote: Diese Entscheidung können Sie mit dem Widerspruch angreifen, den Sie binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift an den Landkreis Beispiel-Seenplatte, Der Landrat, Seenplattenring 12, 17033 Neu Beispielhagen, richten.
items.computation: Letter is dated 09.12.2025 (Tuesday); assumed posted same day via ordinary mail ('einfache Post'). Per the letter's own notice, citing § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG M-V, the decision is deemed notified (bekannt gegeben) on the fourth day after posting. Counting from the posting day as day 0 (not included): day 1 = 10.12., day 2 = 11.12., day 3 = 12.12., day 4 = 13.12.2025 (Saturday) = deemed Bekanntgabe. This fiction of notification is not shifted even though it falls on a Saturday (the weekend/holiday rule of § 31 VwVfG i.V.m. § 193 BGB applies only to the final day of a running deadline, not to the day a notice fiction occurs). The one-month Widerspruch period then runs from the day after Bekanntgabe (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB analog) and, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the Bekanntgabe day, i.e. 13.01.2026. 13.01.2026 is a Tuesday and not a public holiday in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, so no further shift applies. The Widerspruch must reach the Landkreis in writing (or be declared for the record) by this date.

warnings: The exact postal dispatch date is not stated in the letter; the deadline computation assumes dispatch on the letter's own date (09.12.2025), which is the standard but unverified assumption — if actual posting was later, the deadline shifts accordingly.

The letter applies a four-day (rather than the federally standard three-day) postal notification fiction, citing § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG M-V specifically; this Land-specific rule was taken at face value from the letter's own text.

No fees are charged for this decision ('Für diesen Bescheid werden keine Kosten erhoben.'), so no payment is due; the printed IBAN in the letterhead is not linked to any payment demand in this letter.
